scenes.text: Your new productivity app, Flowly, launches in 24 hours. Ten thousand people are on the waitlist. You're standing at the dashboard wondering: what do you post first?

choices.text: Share the origin story on social media
Send a teaser email to the waitlist

scenes.text: Your post gets 800 shares in an hour. Comments flood in: 'Finally!' and 'I've been waiting for this.' Your phone buzzes non-stop — in the best way.

choices.text: Go live on video to thank early fans
Reach out to three journalists personally

scenes.text: The email goes out with a 58% open rate — nearly double the industry average. Three hundred people click the 'I want early access' button within the first ten minutes.

choices.text: Send a follow-up with a short demo video
DM the most engaged subscribers personally

scenes.text: The live stream draws 1,200 viewers. You demo the core feature — one-click focus mode — and the chat erupts with hearts. Flowly trends on two platforms.

choices.text: Announce a 30-day free trial on the spot
Tease tomorrow's launch with a countdown

scenes.text: One journalist replies within the hour: 'I've been looking for exactly this tool. Can I get an exclusive walkthrough before launch?' You have 20 minutes to decide.

choices.text: Say yes — an exclusive could be huge
Politely decline — you want a fair launch

scenes.text: A competitor announces a nearly identical tool — right now — with a slick video. Your phone lights up with worried messages from your team.

choices.text: Pivot messaging to highlight your unique features

scenes.text: Sign-ups spike 400% in the next hour. The server hiccups briefly — your engineer fixes it in four minutes. By midnight, Flowly has 3,000 active users.

choices.text: Send a thank-you to your first 1,000 users
Post a metrics update to build social proof

scenes.text: The countdown post gets pinned and shared 2,500 times. When launch hits midnight, the app store page crashes from traffic — a good problem.

choices.text: Acknowledge the crash with humour online

scenes.text: The exclusive runs at 8 a.m. on launch day. The headline: 'The focus app that actually works.' Forty-five thousand people click through by noon.

choices.text: Launch a referral programme to capitalise on traffic

scenes.text: Your clear, confident messaging cuts through the noise. Users start posting comparisons — and Flowly wins every thread. Your waitlist doubles overnight.

choices.text: Keep the momentum going with a case study

scenes.text: The price cut announcement feels rushed and your community notices. A few influencers question your confidence. You quickly reframe it as a launch celebration offer.

choices.text: Double down with a value-focused follow-up

scenes.text: The thank-you message is handwritten-style and personal. Users screenshot it and post it everywhere. Flowly is called 'the app that actually cares about its users.'
Launch week closes with 12,000 sign-ups, a 4.8-star rating, and three inbound partnership enquiries. The origin story post is still circulating. Day one is done.
